CustomField.complianceGroup: Integrity - Accurate;Privacy - Non Personal Information;Source - Salesforce
CustomField.description: Lead Outcome Formula field to show image of Lead Outcome from Static Resource.
CustomField.formula: IF( TEXT(Lead_Outcome__c) = 'Opportunity Identified', IMAGE("/resource/CCRM_Opportunity_Identified", TEXT(Lead_Outcome__c),30,150), IF( TEXT(Lead_Outcome__c) = 'No Opportunity', IMAGE("/resource/CCRM_No_Opportunity", TEXT(Lead_Outcome__c),30,110), IF( TEXT(Lead_Outcome__c) = 'Expired', IMAGE("/resource/CCRM_Opportunity_Expired", TEXT(Lead_Outcome__c),30,70), IF( TEXT(Lead_Outcome__c) = 'Referred' ,IMAGE("/resource/CCRM_Opportunity_Referred", TEXT(Lead_Outcome__c),30,80), "None"))))
CustomField.label: Lead Outcome
